D1.question: Which research results ship with the open register in this release
D1.answer: All three: the seven SSVEP follow-ups (new-ssvep-frequencies), Shin2022 with the data-quality page, and IESSEEG with the NeuroLM results (clinical-groups section and the NeuroLM EEGMAT pilot panel)

D2.question: eldBETA one-person CCA score (26/63)
D2.answer: Status and counts only; the score is held, keeping the one-person rule (Stieger, FALCON H2)

D3.question: Register wave 1: state verified re-upload findings
D3.answer: Yes, only facts confirmed by an independent check and backed by a captured original-terms page; factual wording only; a correction route on every row; no prior contact with uploaders
D3.default_kept: HF dataset CSV and card carry no comparison findings unless the owner asks
